Hand Selection

Flop Play

Play a betting round on the flop, then the hand stops — the Range Lab runs out the turn and river on demand. You act before seeing any equity — ranges and numbers are locked until you commit — then you're graded on your equity against the live ranges, the pot odds, implied odds on your draws, and how often these opponents actually fold. Villains use simple heuristics; they're here to make the hand play out, not to model good postflop poker.

Spots I Practice

Every hand starts at one of the selected spots — pick just vs 3-Bet to drill only 3-bet defence. Greyed-out spots have no ranges in the loaded chart set for this table size and these seats. Once a hand is under way it still plays out naturally, so deeper decisions can follow.
